entries.title: Morning inspiration and a visible update history
changes: Gave the morning diagnostic its own mountain-sunrise artwork.
Added this local update history with links to release details and the wiki.

entries.title: Clearer workouts and reliable reports
changes: Fixed effort reports for completed lifts without watch imports.
Added illustrated test guides and separate workout instructions and planning explanations.
Check-ins review explanations and update only what needs changing.

entries.title: Count the lift you actually performed
changes: Added pauses, weighted holds and failure reports to the lifting tools.
Aligned assistant instructions with the current hold calculation.

entries.title: A more complete coaching routine
changes: Added check-in attention lists and recorded race predictions.
Exposed current calibration, cross-sport rules and structured lifting through the assistant.

entries.title: Review the whole sequence
changes: Added a two-week running and lifting outlook.
Preview and approve calendar repairs and evidence-supported capacity changes.

entries.title: Guided setup and progression
changes: Added guided bike setup and recent-week review.
Expanded phase-specific starter progression and the simulated athlete journey.

entries.title: Apply the plan you reviewed
changes: Locked program changes to an exact reviewed draft.
Added calendar evidence, formula inspection and swim equipment including fins and snorkels.

entries.title: Smaller, more usable planning context
changes: Made program previews easier for assistants to read.
Verified the desktop extension installation and planning workflow.

entries.title: Build and compare programs
changes: Added program preview, apply and progress evidence.
Compare three proposed workloads before choosing a starter program.

entries.title: Bring lifting into the Hub
changes: Added lifting prescriptions, logs, follow-ups and Sunday reviews.

entries.title: Connect an assistant
changes: Published the first one-file MCP bundle for coaching, rides, imports and training load.

entries.title: The first public release
changes: The repository began its public history as a stationary-bike training hub.
During the following week it grew into a shared place for coaching, multisport load, recovery and program planning.
